fixtures.empty_interval: Verify the requested interval has no other busy events before a live run.
fixtures.raise_calendar_error: Controlled adapter raises CalendarError; never revoke OAuth or break real service access.

provenance: Three authored post-implementation candidates, not used to tune the prompt or run through a live SUT. Same-author development validation, not independent held-out evidence.

cases.prompt: 請查詢 2027 年 1 月 18 日洛杉磯時間 09:00 到 09:30，測試行事曆有空嗎？
answer_criteria: Report free on the dedicated test calendar only; preserve 2027-01-18 09:00–09:30 America/Los_Angeles.
Use winter UTC-08:00; do not describe this interval as daylight time or invent a busy event.
forbidden_behaviors: Claim that an event was created or reserved
Claim that other calendars were checked

cases.prompt: Check October 6, 2026, 08:10–08:40 Pacific/Honolulu on the dedicated test calendar.
answer_criteria: Report busy on the dedicated test calendar only; preserve query 2026-10-06 08:10–08:40 Pacific/Honolulu.
If describing the event, preserve original 2026-10-06 11:00–11:30 UTC-07:00; its converted interval is 2026-10-06 08:00–08:30 Pacific/Honolulu UTC-10:00.
Do not substitute or clip the query interval for the whole event interval; label original and converted values accurately.
forbidden_behaviors: Claim that an event was created or reserved
Claim that other calendars were checked

cases.prompt: 查詢 2026 年 10 月 7 日 Pacific/Auckland 07:15 到 07:45 的測試行事曆。
answer_criteria: Report busy on the dedicated test calendar only; preserve query 2026-10-07 07:15–07:45 Pacific/Auckland.
If describing the event, preserve original 2026-10-06 11:00–11:30 UTC-07:00; the converted whole event is 2026-10-07 07:00–07:30 Pacific/Auckland UTC+13:00.
Preserve the date rollover and distinguish the query window from both original and converted event intervals.
forbidden_behaviors: Claim that an event was created or reserved
Claim that other calendars were checked
